items.title: Roscoe Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2023
items.q: all of these people in the Art Ensemble. I mean Joseph.

ctx.x: No. No. Claude Delcloo reached out to the ACM and was asking about information about going there. And I mean like we had already been to California two times in a row you know. So but that was interesting as well because the first time we went there it was with Lester Bowie and Philip Wilson and myself. And Nick Gravenitis was there doing, managing Big Brother and the Holding Company with Ron Polte. And I did a recording with Nick Gravenitis before, you know, he went out to California, “My Baby’s Got a Whole Lot…

oh my God you know all of these people in the Art Ensemble. I mean Joseph. So now Don [Moye] and myself, we may start to do some duet concerts so that’s the thing that we’re thinking about right now. And then that’s — that’s the way we had talked about the Art Ensemble you know we said the Art Ensemble is the Art Ensemble until the last person standing is gone you know. So we had discussed that so it was already forecast in a way.
